figurative_meaning_en: Over time, in the course of time
example_sentences_in_bangla: কালে কালে সবকিছু পরিবর্তন হয়ে যায়।
কালে কালে সে তার ভুল বুঝতে পারবে।
example_sentences_in_english: In the course of time, he will realize his mistake.
history: This idiom is derived from the Bengali proverb 'কালে কালে কতই হল, পুলি পিঠের লেজ গজালো', which illustrates that over time, even seemingly impossible things can happen, like a lizard growing a tail on the roof.
note: Often used to express gradual change or inevitability over time.
